description_en: Deletes a skill group in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the AICCS instance ID and skill group ID
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、技能组ID删除悉犀客服工作台技能组
name: RemoveSkillGroup

parameters.description_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview).
parameters.description_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取。
parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.

parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
Skill group ID.  

You can invoke the [QuerySkillGroups](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups) API and check the **SkillGroupId** field in the response to obtain the skill group ID.
parameters.description_zh:
技能组ID。

可调用[QuerySkillGroups](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups)接口，查看返回参数的**SkillGroupId**，即技能组ID。
